text: Destina is the brand of Destination Sport Limited (UK company 09564446, Manchester), whose Companies House persons-with-significant-control register names The Portman Travel Group Limited (no. 08831424) with 75% or more of its shares and voting rights and the right to appoint or remove its directors; Portman Travel Group describes Destination Sport Group as the sports travel division of its travel-brand portfolio.
short: Destina (Destination Sport) is controlled by The Portman Travel Group Limited (UK).
